Constraints.description:
Explicit constraints. Unspecified constraints are recorded as absent and are
never interpreted as permission.

Hunk.description:
Replace `old_text` (which must match the file exactly, starting at the
1-based line `start_line`) with `new_text`. Both are whole lines, including
their line endings. An empty `old_text` inserts before `start_line`.

oneOf.description: Network access is forbidden; plans that may use the network are rejected.
No statement either way. Not interpreted as permission.

description:
Plan a modification of one file as a patch against a known version.
Nothing is written until the returned plan is approved by digest and started.

expected_sha256.description:
`sha256` of the file as it was when the patch was prepared (from
`file.read`). Omit to create a file that must not exist yet.

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key (and same inputs) returns the same plan.

intent.description: Why; shown to the approver. Defaults to `Edit <path>`.

title: PlanEditParams
